xna-type.name: VertexChannel
xna-type.summary: Provides methods and properties for maintaining a vertex channel.
xna-type.syntax: public abstract class VertexChannel : IList, ICollection, IEnumerable

property.name: Count
property.summary: Gets the number of elements in the vertex channel

property.name: ElementType
property.summary: Gets the type of data contained in this channel.
property.syntax: public virtual abstract Type ElementType { get; }
property.remarks: To access strongly typed content data, cast the VertexChannel object to a VertexChannel<T> before calling ElementType . This causes a generic enumerator interface to be returned.

property.name: Item
property.summary: Gets or sets the element at the specified index.

property.name: Name
property.summary: Gets the name of the vertex channel.

method.name: Contains
method.summary: Determines whether the specified element is in the channel.

overload.summary: Determines whether the specified element is in the channel.
overload.returns: true if the element is present; false otherwise.

method.name: CopyTo
method.summary: Copies the elements of the channel to an array, starting at the specified index.

overload.summary: Copies the elements of the channel to an array, starting at the specified index.

parameters.parameter: Array that will receive the copied channel elements.

method.name: GetEnumerator
method.summary: Gets an enumerator interface for reading channel content.

overload.summary: Gets an enumerator interface for reading channel content.
overload.remarks: To access strongly typed content data, cast the VertexChannel object to a VertexChannel<T> before calling GetEnumerator . This causes a generic enumerator interface to be returned.

method.name: IndexOf
method.summary: Gets the index of the specified item.

overload.summary: Gets the index of the specified item.

parameters.parameter: Item whose index is to be retrieved.
